# Verification of Compile State

The verify feature conducts a shadow compile, collecting and normalizing data without writing any changes. It compares the current state of the repository with the last full compile, ensuring consistency and enabling easy detection of divergences.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
